correctness.rationale: Proved component closure using full clique lines and Hamming squares, leading to proper coordinate faces; distinct omitted components must be >=3 apart. Converse verifies domination and at-most-one outside neighbor. Crossing-edge inequality (q_*-1)|T| <= e(T,D) <= |D| yields sharp lower bound; equality forces a single q_*-coordinate hyperplane and enumerates all optimizers. Finite exhaustive direct-definition and geometric tests plus independent integer programs corroborate, without substituting for proof.

originality.rationale: The unrestricted face-code equivalence for arbitrary many Cartesian clique factors, including unequal alphabets, is not covered by the found product bounds, two-factor rook-graph results, uniform perfect-coloring literature, or maximal-nearly-perfect-set product estimates. Uniform/binary and two-factor numerical special cases are acknowledged as covered. Residual risk of equivalent older subcube-code terminology is reported.

value.rationale: Full structural characterization of every one-limited dominating set by separated coordinate-face codes, plus sharp min and complete optimizer count for arbitrarily many unequal clique factors. Solves the product upper-value question in this substantial family, with q_*>2 cases not settled by generic N/2 lower bounds. A natural infinite graph construction and equality-rigidity result, not an arbitrary finite slice.
